### Contributing guidelines

- [X] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

### Module(s)

mini.pick

### Question

I tried to disable the `statuscolumn`, but it remains visible in the pick preview.
![imagen](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/089d1db1-8659-4549-b2c4-6dfe09244f47)

###  Code Used
```lua
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd({ "FileType", "BufEnter" }, {
    pattern = {
        "minipick*",
    },
    callback = function(ev)
        vim.b[ev.buf].statuscolumn_disable = true
    end,
})
```
I’m not sure what the correct pattern is for the pick preview buffer. How can I properly match it?

comment_data.body:
This statuscolumn does not come from 'mini.nvim' and likely from some other plugin, so I am not sure if `statuscolumn_disable` works there. The picker window is already set to not show statuscolumn (as there is `style = 'minimal'` which explicitly disables it), so *something* enables statuscolumn in that window.

As preview buffers don't have filetype (by design to not trigger `FileType` autocommands as they can be costly), so 'minipick*' pattern wouldn't match them. So there are several approaches here:
- Write own global [`source.preview`](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/a84b7e555fe382c1859e6ca46b4983c822a1f77f/doc/mini-pick.txt#L385) which disables statuscolumn in that buffer. I have doubts that this will work (as statuscolumn is a window-local option), but maybe the plugin providing it will work like that.
- Update statuscolumn plugin to be more careful in when it autoenables statuscolumn. For example, enabling it when the scratch buffer is shown in floating window is probably not a good idea.

>         preview = function(buf_id, item)
>             vim.b.statuscolumn_disable = true
>             MiniPick.default_preview(buf_id, item)
>         end,

Did you try `vim.b[buf_id].statuscolumn_disable = true`?

I think [this](https://github.com/krovuxdev/NeoClean/blob/cf752cc8f622e34da24cf82b39b8fa8381fe8a3f/plugin/statuscolumn.lua#L46-L51) is the main issue. I'd suggest to just set the global 'statuscolumn' and not rely on `vim.b.ministatuscolumn_disable` at all (instead suggesting setting 'statuscolumn' directly).

reply_data.bodyHTML:
I don't think this is the right solution. I realized that after removing the autocmd, everything else stopped working except the preview in MiniPick. I think I'm having a lot of issues updating my statuscolumn, and nothing seems to work. I suppose I'll apply filetype for the MiniPick preview since that worked for me.
If someone is having issues with another plugin like statuscolumn, try applying filetype in the preview function, like this:

MiniPick.setup({
    source = {
        preview = function(buf_id, item)
            MiniPick.default_preview(buf_id, item)
            vim.bo[buf_id].filetype = "minipick"
        end,
    },
})

(@echasnovski In my opinion, filetype should be added for the preview.)

I am not sure why you have those issues. In my current config [I define 'statuscolumn' once](https://github.com/echasnovski/nvim/blob/8d54183ebfbae2f0dfed8d90c4dbee7d9709a4ba/plugin/20_mini.lua#L70) and it works as expected: is shown in normal windows and not shown in 'mini.pick' preview. There are issues with visible characters in some special buffers (like 'help' and built-in terminal), but that needs to be solved in the 'statuscolumn' logic (like don't show any separator characters if all special gutter columns are disabled).

> (@echasnovski In my opinion, `filetype` should be added for the preview.)

That is not for 'mini.pick' to decide but for each source separately. *Maybe* it is reasonable to set `minipick-preview` for default preview, but this:
- Feels awkward as preview basically can show content visually indistinguishable from other filetype.
- Won't solve the issue of "act inside any 'mini.pick' preview" as sources might set their own filetype.
